question: What is gross margin by category?
referenceSql: SELECT p.Category, SUM(ol.Quantity * (ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount) - ol.UnitCost)) AS GrossMargin FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId GROUP BY p.Category ORDER BY p.Category
